description: Loan amortization schedule: Monthly payment, total interest and the full per-period schedule (interest, principal, balance; up to 480 rows, dated when a start date is given) for a fully-amortizing loan. Arithmetic only. Source: computation. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: monthly_payment, total_interest, schedule[]{period, date, payment, interest, principal, balance}.

annual_rate_pct.description: annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5

schedule.description: true (default) or false to omit the rows
